$comment: Phase 8 progression values. These were TypeScript constants when Phase 8 landed; the project's rule is that balance lives in data (DL-047). Everything under newGamePlus and legacy.unlocks is a data-driven default PENDING APPROVAL — v1.0 §12 and §20 name New Game+ carry-over and cycle rules as decisions the design owner makes, not the implementation.

guildMastery.$comment: level = floor(sqrt(points / pointsPerLevelCurve)) + 1. Activity points are what each kind of real work contributes.

capability.$comment: REQ-CAP-001 readings. Each axis is read on its own; these only say how raw inputs become a reading.

legacy.$comment: Points per Monument achievement kind, and how many of that kind can award points in one cycle. The cap is what keeps Legacy bounded: routine contracts and repeat legendary finds still go on the Monument, but they cannot be farmed into unlimited Legacy (DL-047).

unlocks.name: Prepared Caravan
unlocks.description: Offers an extra-provisions opening in a future cycle.

unlocks.name: Veteran Records
unlocks.description: Reveals fuller candidate histories during recruitment.

unlocks.name: Mentor Hall
unlocks.description: Allows retired hunters to serve as mentors.

unlocks.name: Frontier Exile
unlocks.description: Offers a lean, expedition-focused starting archetype.

unlocks.name: Long Winter
unlocks.description: Unlocks a harsher food-economy world variant.

unlocks.name: Carved Founders
unlocks.description: Adds the founding roster to the Monument facade.

apprentices.$comment: Generational play (v1.0 §11, REQ-LEG-004): a mentor can take on an apprentice, who may inherit one of the mentor's Legacy Traits. PENDING APPROVAL — a data-driven default.

rebirth.$comment: Approved design-owner rules: five journeys, cumulative growth bonuses, and one level-only constellation bypass per journey.

mentors.$comment: Per-mentor bonuses, each capped, then the guild-wide total capped. practiceCap bounds mastery training and training efficiency together, because both apply to the same practice session.

newGamePlus.$comment: PENDING APPROVAL (v1.0 §12, §20). Openings and archetypes are what the matching Legacy unlocks do when a cycle begins.

long_winter.name: Long Winter
long_winter.description: Every resident eats half again as much. Granaries and hunting matter from the first season.
